489-3693-4659-5224.description:

Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.

Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.

Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.

Repeat.

Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.

643-1524-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ilharg.
When Ilharg dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Ilharg's power, which will cause you to mill Ilharg.
As Ilharg is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Ilharg from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-2921-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

579-2366-3499-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-3499-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

6761-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
6761-6798-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

856-2034-2173-5220.description:

When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-2438-4616-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Myr Welder using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
132-1283-2816.notes: You can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability if mana allows and if you control a colored permanent.

Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1170-1418-3389-5954-6763.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-907-1772.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Skirk Alarmist.

Resolve the Missy ability, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Skirk Alarmist trigger, untapping it.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

2660-3318-5094.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.

Resolve the Fabled Passage ability, searching your library for Fabled Passage and putting it onto the battlefield.

307-2232-3821.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature that can attack this turn.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
Peregrine Drake does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
307-2232-3821.description:
Declare Peregrine Drake and any other creature as attackers.
When they are unblocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.

Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thousand-Faced Shadow trigger, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
